title: Private deployment — Lyra weekly sync (2026-09-28)
content:
Attendees: Ava Martinez (SE), Samir Patel (Eng), Jordan Lee (Customer TAM), Priya Shah (Lyra infra lead), Ken Wu (Security)

Objective: Weekly sync to track VPC/on-prem milestones for Lyra private deployment, unblock actions, and align owners/ETAs.

Agenda:
- Quick status round (5m)
- VPC networking & VPN connectivity (10m)
- On-prem install progress & infra (10m)
- Security & compliance checklist (10m)
- Blockers & escalations (10m)
- Action items review (5m)

1) Status highlights
- Test environment up in Lyra lab (k8s cluster configured) — Priya. Basic health checks green except inter-node MTU mismatch.
- Control plane (private CP) config completed by Redwood; initial auth handshake successful.
- Observability agent (replay-proxy) image staged; manual deployment pending.

2) Networking / VPC & VPN
- Current: VPN tunnel established between Redwood VPC and Lyra edge router. Intermittent packet loss observed ~0.5% during peak test traffic (see PLAT-893).
- Root cause: MTU mismatch + IPsec fragmentation on Lyra router firmware v2.4.
- Temporary mitigation: lower PMTU on tunnel to 1400 (applied by Lyra). Packet loss dropped to ~0.03% in limited runs.
- Next: schedule firmware upgrade or route MTU fix with Lyra network team.

3) On-prem install & infra
- Installer script (redwood-onprem-1.3.sh) runs but fails on step "kv-cache init" intermittently. Logs point to ephemeral /tmp race condition on first boot. (linked PR 612 for workaround).
- Workaround: add podInit sleep + retry loop to installer. Engineering to push hotfix.
- Storage: NFS mount validated; performance tests show baseline throughput within expected range for 8k token batches.

4) Security & compliance
- Ken confirmed KMS integration test passed in lab using Lyra's HSM. Need to capture attestation artifacts and provide audit log schema to Lyra security.
- Pending: SOC2 evidence mapping for private deployment — customer asked for items list by next week.

5) Blockers / Risks
- Blocker A: Installer flaky failure (kv-cache init) — blocks canary rollout to Lyra acceptance env. Severity: high.
- Blocker B: Router firmware upgrade coordination — needs Lyra network ops window. Severity: medium.
- Risk: If MTU not fixed, long tail latency may increase under production traffic patterns; recommend soak test before rollout.

Decisions from meeting:
- Proceed with hotfix to installer; will include retry logic and improved logging. (Samir owns).
- Lyra to open a change window for router firmware upgrade next week; Redwood SRE to standby for support. (Jordan & Priya).
- Provide SOC2 evidence mapping doc draft by 2026-10-05. (Ken).

Action items (owner — ETA — notes):
- Samir Patel — 2026-09-30 — implement and ship installer hotfix (retry + better /tmp handling). Create PR and link to PLAT-893.
- Ava Martinez — 2026-09-29 — coordinate oncall schedule for canary rollout; confirm time window with Lyra.
- Jordan Lee — 2026-10-01 — confirm Lyra change window for router firmware upgrade and share exact maintenance window.
- Priya Shah (Lyra) — 2026-09-30 — run extended soak test with PMTU=1400 and report packet loss/latency metrics to #lyra-deploy.
- Ken Wu — 2026-10-05 — draft SOC2 evidence mapping for private deployment and share Confluence link.
- Infra (rotation: Owen) — 2026-10-02 — validate observability agent deployment and collect agent logs for the intermittent kv-cache init failure case.

Notes / Scratchpad:
- If installer hotfix isn't sufficient, fallback is to orchestrate a manual init step via SSH for affected nodes — documented in runbook draft (see Confluence link in linked_artifacts).
- Consider adding a preflight MTU probe to installer to detect and set optimal tunnel PMTU automatically. Low priority but would reduce ops friction.
- Need to add a test case to CI that reproduces /tmp race on cold boot (assign to infra tests backlog).

Next sync: 2026-10-05 10:00 PT. Suggested agenda: post-hotfix status, firmware upgrade outcome, SOC2 evidence draft review, canary rollout plan.

Attachments / references: PLAT-893 (Jira), PR-612 (infra fix draft), Confluence: Private Deployment > Lyra page, Slack: #lyra-deploy
